===Previous Sinecures===
* The Gardens of Pallas, overseen by the [[Head Gardener of Urizen]] were burned by the Druj shortly before the Spring Equinox 382YE.
* The Glorious Fountain, overseen by the [[Keeper of the Glorious Fountain]] was destroyed by the Druj during their invasion of Morrow after the Summer Solstice 382YE.
